tasks.goal: Expose current-project active architecture environments through the public release contract and block deleting referenced environments.
input_facts: Boot already adapts ReleaseMasterDataQuery to ReleaseArchitectureDirectory.
invariants: No release access to arch_ tables.
interface_contracts: Active environment projections include id, code, name and type.
non_goals: Changing architecture environment CRUD behavior other than delete-reference protection.
action_bounds: Extend only existing public contracts and scoped deletion path.
tasks.rollback: Revert scoped source and contract changes.
stop_conditions: A direct architecture-to-release module dependency is required.
escalation_conditions: Existing delete transaction cannot perform the reference guard.

tasks.goal: Remove private release drill environment APIs and UI, and make drills validate and display architecture environment projections.
input_facts: Release drill round already persists environment_id.
T1 provides a release-owned environment directory.
invariants: Existing release project-member authorization remains active.
environmentId continues to be the HTTP field.
interface_contracts: Release resolves environment IDs through ReleaseArchitectureDirectory.
non_goals: Frontend direct use of architecture API.
action_bounds: Remove only private environment route/API/component and replace the drill selection source.
acceptance_checks: Private endpoint and route are absent.
Invalid architecture environment is rejected on save.
Empty environment selection disables new drill creation.
tasks.rollback: Revert scoped application changes before V217.
stop_conditions: Reading options requires an architecture private frontend API.
escalation_conditions: Existing roles cannot read directory options without role-model changes.

tasks.goal: Destructively remove legacy release drill data, table, menu and grants in V217.
input_facts: User explicitly approved data removal without compatibility.
invariants: Only approved legacy environment, drill, step, issue and menu/grant data are removed.
interface_contracts: release drill environment_id semantic changes only after cleanup migration.
non_goals: Restoring data or migrating legacy environment values.
action_bounds: Append one migration after inspecting published schema.
acceptance_checks: Legacy dependent rows are deleted before the old table is dropped.
Menu 1006 and related grants are retired.
tasks.rollback: Data recovery requires a pre-V217 backup.
stop_conditions: An unapproved dependent table is found.
escalation_conditions: Cleanup would remove data beyond the approved scope.

tasks.goal: Run regression, migration, scope and browser observations for the complete replacement.
acceptance_checks: Focused/full module tests, frontend build, governance, scope and browser path.
stop_conditions: Cross-project or inactive environment is accepted.
escalation_conditions: Verification requires an out-of-scope shared change.

dependency_edges.reason: Final checks observe the migrated state.
